name: Nissan Skyline GTR R33 Nismo
author: Remco, abbo90 and CM-M
description: The Nissan Skyline GT-R R33 Nismo 400R is the ultimate evolution of the ninth-generation Skyline GT-R, produced in 1997 as a homologation special limited to just 99 units. Developed by Nismo (Nissan Motorsport International), the 400R features an extensively modified RB26DETT twin-turbocharged 2.8-liter inline-six engine, enlarged from the standard 2.6 liters with a stroker kit and upgraded N1 turbos, producing 400 PS (394 hp). This tuned variant pushes output significantly beyond stock, showcasing the legendary RB26's potential for massive power gains. The 400R features aggressive Nismo bodywork including wider fenders, a distinctive front bumper, and rear spoiler for improved aerodynamics. Power is delivered through a Getrag six-speed manual transmission to Nissan's ATTESA E-TS all-wheel-drive system with an active limited-slip differential. The R33 GT-R famously set a production car lap record at the Nurburgring Nordschleife in 1995, earning it legendary status among JDM enthusiasts worldwide.
